title: Bạn có thể cho tôi một mức giá tốt hơn?

pronunciation: Ban co the cho toi mot muc gia tot hon
summary: Can you give me a better price?

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Bạn có thể cho tôi một mức giá tốt hơn? is the quick money check before you agree to a ride, ticket, item, or service. It keeps the exchange focused on Can you give me a better price, so the answer can be a number, calculator screen, or typed price.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask Bạn có thể cho tôi một mức giá tốt hơn? before you hand over money. Keep the item, ticket, ride screen, or calculator visible so the price can be shown instead of explained quickly.
